title: One Hash Bloom Filters
summary: An article presenting an optimized variant of Bloom filters that uses only a single hash function instead of traditional multiple hash functions, reducing computational overhead while maintaining space efficiency and probabilistic membership testing capabilities.
problem_solved: Reduces the computational overhead of traditional Bloom filters that require multiple hash functions, simplifying implementation and potentially improving cache performance.
why_valuable: Provides a more efficient Bloom filter implementation that maintains constant-time lookups with reduced hash computations, making it valuable for memory-efficient set membership testing in high-performance applications.
